high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals standing on a red carpet in front of a wooden backdrop adorned with the Omega logo. The backdrop is made of vertical wooden planks, giving it a rustic yet elegant appearance. The Omega logo is prominently displayed at the top center of the backdrop, with smaller logos scattered across the surface. The person on the left is wearing a light pink button-up shirt paired with dark blue trousers and black sneakers. He has his hands casually placed in his pockets and is smiling warmly at the camera.
